resources.string: An estimate. It cannot replace a lab test, and it must not be used to adjust a dose.
Calibration needs the sublingual estimate, which is not available right now.
When routes are added together, the background baseline is counted once.
Some records have an unknown route, dose or time and are not part of this total. Repair them to include them.
Calibration scales the whole E2 total by one factor fitted to your lab results. The background level is not scaled, and no record is changed.
Enough lab information: the labs fix the scale of your curve well.
Limited lab information: the scale is only roughly fixed. More labs taken at different times would help.
Predicting each lab from the others is off by about %1$d%% (median).
Only one lab result is used, so it cannot be cross-checked.
%1$d lab result(s) taken soon after a sublingual dose count for less, because the exact time matters most there.
the dose history before the sample is incomplete or covers less than 24 hours
only the date was recorded, not the time of day
no recorded sublingual dose before the sample
the value or time cannot be used
No lab result can be used yet, so the curve stays uncalibrated.
The usable labs say too little about your own scale, so the curve stays uncalibrated.
Calibration uses the sample times you recorded for each lab.
